prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve / targeted pixel-art portrait revision. Image 1 is the portrait to EDIT, images 2-5 are the four style anchors. Do not reproduce the current large bright eye whites or worried eyebrows; those are the defects to fix. Produce exactly one revised isolated portrait. Preserve this person's identity, sex, age, face shape, hairstyle silhouette, head angle and clothing colors. Maintain the extreme close head crop and 74:100 aspect ratio. This is the one targeted quality revision, not a new character.
Change the expression from the current conspicuously raised-inner-brow worried look to guarded alertness with self-respect. Keep the brows low and almost LEVEL, with only subtle asymmetry, not inward-raised pleading arches. Keep the same eye direction, but make each eye opening smaller and low in contrast. Dark iris/pupil fills nearly the entire eye opening; the sclera is only a TINY dull warm-brown/ochre-gray sliver equivalent to at most ONE logical pixel, NO ivory, cream or white area. Keep the tired adult lower lids, straight shut mouth and lean cheeks; no scowl, sadness, frightened stare or villain grin.
Retain the short gray-black haircut but MERGE the many long parallel gray strand marks into 4-6 BROAD CONNECTED hair masses with sparse stepped shadow boundaries. Do not add more hair, no fine comb lines. Keep the recognizable stubble as broad gray-charcoal jaw planes, not stippled beard texture. The neck should be shorter: lower jaw/chin sits closer to the bottom, with only a narrow blue-gray collar and small brown leather apron edge. His left ear, visible on viewer-right, has a subtle OLD triangular notch in its upper outer rim, no blood or fresh injury.
Keep broad, crisp, hard-edged pixel clusters designed on a 74x100 logical grid. Firm cheekbones, nose wings and adult jaw planes, earth-toned flat ramps, near-black stepped contour, at most 32 logical colors. No antialiasing, smoothing, gradients, dither, speckle, high-frequency texture, glossy highlights or isolated decorative pixels. No added objects, hair ornaments, rank symbols, text, frame, panel, chest, hands or background. True transparent alpha outside the portrait silhouette. Do not change the latest approved costume colors. Preserve the strong facial geometry rather than beautifying or rounding it.
Independent QA emphasis: the current visible ear has an intact outer contour. Show a SMALL CLEAR MISSING WEDGE in the UPPER OUTER RIM of his LEFT ear on viewer-right, breaking its silhouette, like an old healed ear notch; this is NOT a line painted inside the ear. No blood. Compress the bare neck by roughly one third, bringing the narrow blue-gray collar closer to the jaw. Preserve the lean forty-year-old face. Remove the saw-toothed tiny spikes from the crown; keep only a few coherent coarse hair locks.
